_why: Which scripts in sim/world/tools/ CI runs (the world job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, through tools/world-checks.mjs and tools/gate.mjs --verdict) and which it leaves out, and why. Every .gd file there must be in one list or the other: tools/world-checks.mjs --verify fails on an unclassified script, so a new check cannot be forgotten and a new probe has to say it is one. A check is a script that prints a verdict line 'NAME: N check(s) failed' (or 'NAME: N failed') and ends; most quit with a plain quit() (exit 0) whatever they found, so the verdict line is the result (tools/gate.mjs --verdict). Measured 2026-10-30 on HEAD, three at a time at below-normal priority: all 48 pass, 169 s wall, 472 s added up one after another.

leaveOut.b_heights: measurement: prints percentiles of dry land on B plates, no verdict
leaveOut.calm_digest: measurement: prints the calm turn's swap tick and gameplay hashes, no verdict
leaveOut.campaign_turns: measurement: how often the campaign ring turns, for tuning, no verdict
leaveOut.flighthooks_probe: probe: Simulation's gate list runs it
leaveOut.gen2_soak: soak: long, run by World by hand and by QA's gen 2 baseline
leaveOut.gen_cost: measurement: the cost of generating a planet, no verdict
leaveOut.ground_strip: report: draws a strip of ground for a look, no verdict
leaveOut.planet_digest: digest: prints hashes for a before and after comparison, no verdict
leaveOut.planet_map: report: draws the planet map for a look, no verdict
leaveOut.planet_measure: measurement of the planet's shape, no verdict
leaveOut.read_digest: digest: a hash of the planet's reads, for before and after, no verdict
leaveOut.ringcount: probe: structures per ring and place kind, no verdict
leaveOut.skyline: report: scratch generator report for the districts slice, no verdict
leaveOut.terrain_audit: audit over real matches (reads the matches' terrain, no verdict)
leaveOut.turn_ticks: profile: the cost of each tick of a calm turn's warm-up, no verdict
